parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: OnlyCustom
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to filter the assets that support custom checks. Valid values:

*   **true**: Filter assets that support custom checks.
*   **false**: All assets are selected. This is the default value.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region in which the asset resides. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: International
*   **ap-southeast-1**: Singapore

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas list-instance-catalog --lang zh --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --types RISK --standard-ids 2 --requirement-ids 27 --only-custom true --task-sources YAO_CHI --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ListInstanceCatalog --region cn-hangzhou --StandardIds.1 2 --Types.1 RISK --OnlyCustom true --RequirementIds.1 27 --TaskSources.1 YAO_CHI --Lang zh --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
